meta.title: From customer yes to Order Ready

messages.label: customer said yes: tick job lines for one supplier
messages.note: Each ticked line orders its selected candidate from that supplier; the quantity comes from the line. Unticked lines can go on a later order.

messages.label: POST /api/orders
messages.note: { jobRequestId, supplierId, jobRequestItemIds, additionalDetails } for one job.

messages.label: create_order
messages.note: Copies each selected candidate onto the open order, or a new one.

messages.label: order New · job Committed
messages.note: The job moves from Quote or Availability to Committed.

messages.label: optional: PATCH /api/orders/:orderId { isPublic }
messages.note: Issues a share-link token for the order.

messages.label: GET /api/public/orders/:token
messages.note: Read-only view. Confirming happens in the partner portal.

messages.label: Acknowledge Received: PATCH /api/partner/:id/orders/:orderId
messages.note: Sends { status: processing } only; acknowledging takes no input.

messages.label: update_partner_order
messages.note: New → Processing only; stamps the confirmation date; no date needed.

messages.label: POST /webhook/rosie/supplier-events/notify
messages.note: order_updated (processing) to jr-<job id>. Best effort: a failed alert never undoes the save.

messages.label: optional: POST …/orders/:orderId/status-notification
messages.note: After saving line statuses; wakes Rosie with order_status_saved.

messages.label: new status + supplier note, in the job's thread
messages.note: Rosie re-reads the order and posts the actual status in the job's chat; the job stays Committed.

cards.title: What makes a job Committed
items: Creating a supplier order moves its job from Quote or Availability to Committed (staff can also set a job's status by hand).
Chris orders once the customer has said yes; the app asks for no confirmation flag.
An order belongs to one job and one supplier; a job has at most one open order per supplier, and each candidate goes on one order only.

cards.title: Order statuses
items: New → Processing → Order Ready, no skipping or going back.
Neither step needs a fulfillment date and the order stores none; the date and pickup/delivery are the job's.
On the job card staff can mark ready and edit additional details and the change log (PATCH /api/orders/:orderId), but not acknowledge, and that route does not wake Rosie.

cards.title: How Rosie hears about it
items: The app server posts a supplier event to Rosie's webhook; it lands on the order's job thread, jr-<job id>.
If the alert fails, the supplier's save still stands; nothing retries it.
order_updated carries the new status and the supplier's note; Rosie re-reads the order and posts it in the job's chat, where Chris sees it.
